He's coming for a limited time only! ːtattletailː

9-inch plush
Feet of an Angel
Not haunted
Has a genuine Egg Hole™ (comes with one plush Gift Egg!)

ːgifteggː Click here to order your own Tattletail™ Plush (Ends March 28th, 2025)
This is a collaboration with Youtooz. These plushies are only available for pre-order from March 7 to March 28th, 2025. After that, you will no longer be able to order them.

notes.title: The Kaleidoscope Expansion
notes.content:
Something is different about Tattletail... ːtattletailːhttp://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27290917/41b3fd7338e3f78ed9c412d0fdea82f529988f77.png

Surprise!! ːgiftegg_greenː The Kaleidoscope Expansion is a whole new campaign that tells a very different story about the events of Christmas 1998. New levels, new story, new scares, and best of all, it's included in this update totally free.

ːmamatattleː Play The Kaleidoscope from the main menu by pressing the icon on the bottom right of the screen. The Kaleidoscope Expansion is only accessible after you have completed the main story at least once.

New Features

    The Kaleidoscope is now available on the main menu once the main story has been completed (with any ending)
    New voice lines for Tattletail & friends
    New secrets and lore to discover
    Mysterious consequences


Bug Fixes & Improvements

    Added support for Inverted Mouse control
    Fixed some screen effects issues


This update is a huge "thank you" to all our Tattletail fans. You can talk about The Kaleidoscope on our discussion board. Me love youuuu hehehee

notes.title: The Gift Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27290917/6a9fa8e7944e25edd969606a349df4d58b747033.png

ːgifteggː Wow!! Tattletail is still a freshly hatched egg but we're blown away by the response so far. Thanks so much for your feedback and for playing and sharing the game :3 OK anyway here's the good stuff:

New Features

Secret ending... only if you've been good.
Special reward for getting the new ending. I can't say what it is.
Level Select now available if you've completed the game once.


Bug Fixes & Improvements

Improved hint system to help make the monster mechanics more clear.
Updated VHS Commercial scene.
Mouse sensitivity should be greatly improved for those having issues.
Whoops. Waygetter Electronics retired the Tattletail with a white ring around its nose earlier in '98. We have updated it to show a more historically accurate Tattletail with a fully red nose.


Well... we're gonna get back to work. Post your feedback on the discussion board, and tell a friend about Tattletail!! It makes a great "GIFT" *wink* Ok me go night night ːtattletailː LOL
